findings.description: Data race: the `RateLimiter` struct is intended for concurrent use across goroutines handling HTTP requests, but the `Allow` method (line 31) reads and writes `rl.clients` map and `ClientState` fields without any synchronization (mutex or sync.Map). Concurrent goroutines calling `Allow` will produce data races on the map and counter fields, causing undefined behavior. Protect access with a `sync.Mutex` or `sync.RWMutex`.
